Malformed data raises `TypeError` or `ValueError`, and inputs are not mutated.

import unittest
from solution import compose_command_catalog


class CommandCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def section(self, namespace="alpha", commands=("run",), metadata=None):
        return {"namespace": namespace, "commands": commands, "metadata": {} if metadata is None else metadata}

    def test_order_conversion_and_empty_sections(self):
        sections = [self.section("b", ["one", "two"]), self.section("a", iter(["x"]))]
        fallback = self.section("fallback", ["default"])
        result = compose_command_catalog(sections, fallback)
        self.assertEqual(result, (
            {"namespace": "system", "commands": ("help",), "metadata": {}},
            {"namespace": "b", "commands": ("one", "two"), "metadata": {}},
            {"namespace": "a", "commands": ("x",), "metadata": {}},
            {"namespace": "fallback", "commands": ("default",), "metadata": {}},
        ))
        self.assertEqual(compose_command_catalog([], fallback)[0]["namespace"], "system")
        self.assertEqual(len(compose_command_catalog([], fallback)), 2)

    def test_metadata_deep_copies_are_independent(self):
        shared = {"nested": {"values": [1]}}
        sections = [self.section("a", ["x"], shared), self.section("b", ["y"], shared)]
        fallback = self.section("fallback", [], shared)
        result = compose_command_catalog(sections, fallback)
        shared["nested"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["metadata"]["nested"]["values"], [1])
        result[1]["metadata"]["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result[2]["metadata"]["nested"]["values"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(result[3]["metadata"]["nested"]["values"], [1])

    def test_exact_keys_and_mapping_validation(self):
        fallback = self.section("fallback")
        bad = [
            {"namespace": "a", "commands": [], "metadata": {}, "extra": 1},
            {"namespace": "a", "commands": []},
        ]
        for section in bad:
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                compose_command_catalog([section], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compose_command_catalog([[]], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compose_command_catalog([], [])

    def test_namespace_rules(self):
        fallback = self.section("fallback")
        for namespace in ("", "   "):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                compose_command_catalog([self.section(namespace)], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compose_command_catalog([self.section(2)], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compose_command_catalog([self.section("system")], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compose_command_catalog([self.section("dup"), self.section("dup")], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compose_command_catalog([self.section("fallback")], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compose_command_catalog([], self.section("system"))

    def test_command_and_metadata_validation(self):
        fallback = self.section("fallback")
        for commands in ("run", ["x", "x"], [""], ["  "], [1]):
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                compose_command_catalog([self.section("a", commands)], fallback)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compose_command_catalog([self.section("a", ["x"], [])], fallback)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
